controls.name: Multi-factor authentication
controls.description: Synthetic MFA blocks password-only transitions and caps the explicitly modelled MFA social-engineering route; existing sessions are unaffected.

rules.reason: Require an additional authentication factor for a password-only transition.
Additional authentication reduces this assumed human-mediated route without claiming complete prevention.

controls.name: Role-based access control
controls.description: Remove modelled privileges that exceed the identity job need; required business permissions remain.

rules.reason: Remove excessive or incorrectly assigned privileges from the synthetic identity.

controls.name: Account disablement
controls.description: Disable stale identities while leaving valid active identities unchanged.

rules.reason: Disable a former worker identity that should no longer be active.

controls.name: Idle session timeout
controls.description: Remove stale idle-session routes; freshly active sessions remain until timeout conditions apply.

rules.reason: Expire a stale idle session; the rule does not match active-session tags.

controls.name: Session revocation
controls.description: Invalidate the active session-token routes explicitly marked in this synthetic model.

rules.reason: Invalidate the referenced authenticated session so token reuse no longer provides a route.

controls.name: Individual staff accounts
controls.description: Remove routes that rely on a shared staff identity.

rules.reason: Replace shared-account access with individual identities, removing this modelled shared-account transition.

controls.name: Privileged reauthentication
controls.description: Require stronger authentication before privileged operations, capping their modelled ordinal likelihood rather than claiming perfect prevention.

rules.reason: A fresh authentication requirement reduces the modelled likelihood of the privileged operation.

controls.name: Administrator restriction
controls.description: Remove unrestricted administrative routes; explicitly required, narrowly scoped roles may remain.

rules.reason: Remove unrestricted administrator authority from this synthetic transition.

controls.name: Device-session separation
controls.description: Prevent session reuse on a different device; reuse on the original authenticated device remains a separate route.

rules.reason: Reject reuse outside the original device context without claiming to prevent same-device misuse.
